reason: I use AI at work all day, but I'm not letting a cartoon pet invest and pay for things with my actual money. My broker already has free AI stuff, and I'm not adding another monthly subscription to babysit a bot.
objection: An AI moving my real money on its own, even inside limits, run by a company that doesn't even have its broker partner or a price yet. One bad decision on a small account like mine actually hurts.
would_change_my_mind: Years of a public track record with real money, from a known licensed broker that guarantees it, and the AI only suggests while I tap every single trade myself, for basically free.
